adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute, poll_feed is gated by three conditions: feed_polling_enabled?, feed_polling_url.present?, and embed_by_username.present?. In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:18, the test only stubs feed_polling_enabled? to false and does not make feed_polling_url or embed_by_username present; given site_settings.yml defaults feed_polling_url: '' and embed_by_username: '' (not present), poll_feed would not be called even if the feed_polling_enabled? check were removed. So the test does not actually verify the presence/necessity of that guard.
